verdict.rationale: Cursor's privacy and data governance docs say that with Privacy Mode enabled, code is never used for training by Cursor or by other AI model providers. Privacy Mode is on by default for Enterprise teams, which directly delivers the opt-out an engineering lead needs. missing for 10: explicit coverage of prompts (docs only say "code"), documentation of how admins toggle or enforce Privacy Mode team-wide on non-Enterprise plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
